data.name: True Arcane Bloodrage
data.description: When you enter a bloodrage, you can choose one of the following spells and apply its effects on you: Beast Shape IV (choose a creature your size or larger only), Form of the Dragon I, or Transformation. This is in addition to Arcane Bloodrage and Greater Arcane Bloodrage, and otherwise works as those abilities.
